identity.normalization: ID-2: AQUA / WATER / EAU, the two Taraxacum synonyms and PARFUM / FRAGRANCE each one entry; normalized one-based positions of the 21-entry list

surfactantSystem: Cocamidopropyl Betaine @2 - amphoteric, earliest prominent cleansing surfactant
Sodium Lauryl Glucose Carboxylate @4 - mild anionic (carboxylate; assigned by chemistry, C3)
Sodium Lauroyl Methyl Isethionate @7 - mild anionic
Not cleansing: Polysorbate 20 @13, Acrylates/C10-30 Alkyl Acrylate Crosspolymer @8

excluded: Acrylates/C10-30 Alkyl Acrylate Crosspolymer @8 (anionic acrylate suspending agent, 6.4)

scalpExposureFlags: Parfum @21 last; Linalool @20; no cooling agent, no essential oil
E4 humectant/refatting routes prominent: Glycerin @5, Glyceryl Oleate @10

skipped: w_line_skipped:Selenium Sulfide@9 - clause (ii) failed: cleansing surfactant Coco-Glucoside @12 listed after it and before the cap
wLine.plausibilityOfWLine: Sodium Benzoate @14: (i) cleansing surfactants before; (ii) between @14 and @21 only Citric Acid, Sodium Chloride, chelator, Potassium Sorbate, 2-Bromo-2-Nitropropane-1,3-Diol (not on list b), Linalool - no cleansing surfactant, alkanolamide or pearlizing wax

cleansingStrength.rationale: Low by C6: no strong anionic; the earliest prominent cleansing surfactant is the amphoteric Cocamidopropyl Betaine @2, followed by glucosides and mild anionics. No C3b member involved.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Low: cleansing-led architecture with no silicone, cationic polymer, cationic conditioner or payload lipid; only Glycerin @5 and the weak refatter Glyceryl Oleate @10.

weightPotential.persistence: low - glyceryl oleate is lightly retained
weightPotential.resetCapacity: weak - mild C6 chassis, but nothing substantive to remove
weightPotential.counterevidence: Selenium sulfide particles are suspended by the acrylate crosspolymer and may deposit on the scalp, but that is an active, not a hair-conditioning residue family.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Low: deposition is absent apart from one weak refatter; no architecture supports reduced movement or lift.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not moderate: no depositing system (silicone, cationic, lipid, protein, film former) is present; a single weak refatter plus humectant cannot plausibly leave noticeable residue even against weak reset.
weightPotential.rationale: Low: only Glyceryl Oleate @10; no payload lipid (W-line Sodium Benzoate @14).

focusPrimary.counterSignal: Selenium Sulfide @9 suggests an anti-dandruff role, but the path needs a dandruff claim (R17.3).
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Claim direction null (blind); formula compatible with scalp_active if anti-dandruff positioning is revealed; provisional general.

focusSecondary.decisionTrace: Empty default considered; no positioning visible.

losingTriggers: treatment possible if a qualifying dandruff claim is revealed

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Provisional: positioning hidden. CSA formula half met via humectant/refatting routes Glycerin @5 and Glyceryl Oleate @10; no E4 comfort route (an S-SENSITIVE gate would fail on the comfort-route clause).

dandruffSupport.rationale: Supported: Selenium Sulfide @9 is a recognized active (DS1, exact INCI name). Formula-only.

uncertainties: Sodium Lauryl Glucose Carboxylate assigned to mild anionic by its carboxylate chemistry (C3 unlisted-surfactant rule); does not affect C6 (betaine is earliest).
2-Bromo-2-Nitropropane-1,3-Diol @19 is a preservative not on W-LINE list b; not a candidate.
